title: New in Symfony 8.2: Console improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony 8.2 is a big release for terminal applications. We already introduced
console sub-commands, the Tui component improvements and the
smarter arguments of invokable commands. This article showcases the rest of
the new features added to the Console component.…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
